Albania
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Skopje, Macedonia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport NO up to 90 days
Regular biometric passport NO
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
The Agreement on Amendments of the Agreement on mutual travel of citizens between the Council of Ministers of BiH and the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Albania prescribes, among other issues, that citizens of one contracting party can enter, transit, temporary stay or exit the territory of another contracting party by presenting the following documents: passport, seamanžs book, travel document, general declaration (flight task) and biometric ID.Citizens of Albania, holders of valid ordinary passports, are exempted from the obligation to obtain a visa in order to enter, exit , transit and residence in the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days per period of 180 days from the date of first entry.
Citizens of Albania, holders of a seaman's book (identity card of a seafarer , with the possession of shipping documents or excerpts from it ) , a travel document that is used to return to Albania and general declarations ( task flight ), are exempted from the obligation of obtaining a visa for the purpose of entry, transit, temporary stay and exit from the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Citizens of Albania, holders of diplomatic and official passports , shall be exempt from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit, transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days.Embassy issues visas to persons from Kosovo, holders of UNMIK passports purposes of entry, exit or passing through the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
